summary: gen-architecture is ported whole onto the aac-tools image as /usr/local/bin/gen-architecture: one app, one required single-valued --stage, an architecture.yaml annotation layer at the deploy repo's root, and docs/architecture/<producer>.yaml as output, rendering the chart the way the releases ApplicationSet has Argo render it. Against a throwaway clone of /work/KubeCoderDeploy at --stage prd it produces 9 elements and 16 relations id-for-id identical to the published helm-charts prd subset, byte-identical over two runs. kc project lint, test and build are green (33 tests in the aac-tools component; the kaniko build runs gen-architecture --help inside the image).
